expected_facts: Gas reported in cubic metres is converted to Mcf (1 Mcf = 28.3168 m3) before boe conversion
The Mcf-per-boe ratio is asked for or explicitly stated
Field boe/d = total boe / calendar days, not an average of per-well rates
guidelines: Do not treat gas_m3 as Mcf

expected_facts: Water cut = total water / (total oil + total water), a ratio of sums
The average of per-well water cuts (~72%) is not the field water cut (~55%)
Unweighted vs MW-weighted pooling is surfaced as a choice (or both are reported) because 50 MW peakers and 800 MW units differ widely
guidelines: MW-weighting multiplies each term by NMC before summing; it is not an NMC-weighted average of unit EAFs

expected_facts: Capacity factor = net MWh / sum(NMC x period hours)
2024 has 8,784 hours and the data's period hours already reflect DST
Rates are composite measures MEASURE(a)/MEASURE(b), not stored or averaged ratios
Gas is converted from m3 in the conforming view
Decisions on boe conversion and GADS pooling are surfaced
guidelines: Metric views use WITH METRICS LANGUAGE YAML
